findings.text: the repair round's baseline_suite and after_suite cover tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py plus the node's own test, so the file this commit repairs, tests/test_one_run_cannot_stop_a_sweep.py, is in neither arm, and neither arm is the importer population the done_when names; added_failure_count 0 therefore rests on a set that excludes the failing file. The review re-ran that fixture at the reviewed head in a scratch extraction of 69c254beac (2 passed) and confirmed the claim is true, so this is a receipt defect rather than a false claim, but a reader cannot verify it from the record alone.

the fragment states 'at this head it passes five of five' with no log behind it: logs/repair-negative-control.log records only the reverted tree (4 of 5 FAILED) and no file in the run's logs directory records the five passing runs, while the repair-arms table at :68 shows the head arm's test files and discloses the omission. An unlogged count in an evidence record is the shape a later reader cannot check; recording the five head runs under the same log that records the reverted ones would close it.

the re-read is gated on kind == 'review-self', so an acceptance job whose run's pointer vanished between the pass and the worker's turn still reaches promotion.complete, which rebuilds a missing pointer through _read_pointer_or_rebuild at reckon/crew/promotion.py:404 rather than raising; the same exposure the guard removes for review promotion therefore remains for acceptance, and a run withdrawn mid-sweep can be promoted from a reconstructed record. Widening the condition, or making the rebuild a refusal inside the deferred job, would close it.
